$comment: Single source of truth for the IDEAS Logo. Edit here, then run `npm run build`. Letter grids: '#' = Voxel, 'o' = Hollow Voxel, '.' = empty. Option A letterforms from the www-ideas prototype, refined and approved by the IDEAS lead in #3: one hand-placed Hollow Voxel per letter on a stroke end, 5x22 grid. Tests pin the Hollow Voxel positions, so moving one is a deliberate change to the test too. themeAccents: the six Slide Template accent colours in chart-series order, ramp colours ordered so no neighbouring pair (including 6 back to 1) clashes in normal vision or with protanopia, deuteranopia or tritanopia (#12); keep lime and amber apart.

icon.$comment: The Icon: a single voxel "i", for favicons, avatars and slide corners, as the www-ideas prototype favicon draws it. Same cell grammar as the Wordmark letters. The tittle is solid, not hollow, so it stays crisp at 16px; the serif and base bar keep the mark sturdy. Unlike the Wordmark, the ramp runs top to bottom: rampSteps gives the ramp index for each row.

fundingAcknowledgment.$comment: The DOE funding acknowledgment (ALCF resources and the ASCR Argonne Base project) on the Slide Template's Closing layout, as given by the IDEAS lead (#9). The www-ideas site footer still carries an older, shorter ASCR sentence.
fundingAcknowledgment.text: This research used resources of the Argonne Leadership Computing Facility, which is a U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science User Facility operated under contract DE-AC02-06CH11357. This work was supported by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of Advanced Scientific Computing Research (ASCR), for the project Argonne Base: Scientific Data Management and Visualization to Advance AI for Science, under Contract DE-AC02-06CH11357.

tagline.$comment: Always lowercase inside the Logo. Each entry is one line of the three-line Tagline, as the www-ideas prototype header wraps it; outlined from the font file at build time, so no output depends on an installed font.
